task_scope: diagnostic_json telemetry grounded in spo/fpo/fsp/etto/ecfo time-series channels

failure_taxonomy.description: Baseline often treated estimated contact-force changes as external obstruction/contact even when positions tracked setpoints and motion or phase context could explain the pattern.
Adapter v1 improved one development case involving normal operation but regressed a previously correct contact-related case and did not reliably correct phase-related cases.
Baseline and previous adapter outputs were valid diagnostic JSON, so there is no recurring format problem requiring an adapter.

fallback_policy: Use the original task specification without an additional adapter.
changes_from_previous: Removed the previous adapter because its behavioral rule was not supported by stable improvement across development folds.
Avoided adding a new phase-diagnosis rule because the available refinement evidence is inconsistent and could further harm previously correct contact-related behavior.
predicted_regression_risks: Broadly downgrading contact-force events to normal or programmed phases can suppress real obstruction or extra-component diagnoses.
Broadly treating sustained contact-force rises as obstruction can miss intended phase-related behavior.
Adding task-phase heuristics from very few development cases may overfit telemetry patterns and harm unseen cases.
evidence_limitations: Only two development items per fold are available.
Adapter v1 did not show stable fold-level improvement over Baseline.
Observed failures involve multiple root-cause classes with similar telemetry signatures, so a reusable rule is not sufficiently supported.
No holdout data or holdout scores were used.
